label: input z/j/y late in the original phase or at the first copy step
explanation: Fires mostly when the input token is z (46% of mass), j or y (together 34%), with weaker firing on h, f and p. It is position-gated. In the original phase it is silent at t<=3 and its rate climbs steeply with position (orig_idx 7-8 has 5-8x lift). In the copy phase it fires mostly at recall_idx 1, the step right after <DEL> where orig(0) is fed back in (38% of mass), and less at recall_idx 2. It never fires at the delimiter step. The largest activations come from z as the first copied token in long sequences (L 8-9). Rate also goes up with L. It does not fire on digits or most other letters. Precision is low because z/j/y in these positions often leave it inactive, so it depends on hidden-state context this predicate does not capture (dev F1 0.39, mass recall 0.61).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=8: z, j, y, f; t=7: z, j, y, f; t=9: z, j, f, h) and the token being output (most: m, u, v, h, s, b; least: o, a, y, c); timing cues that raise it most: L=8 & t=9, recall_idx=1, L=9 & t=8.
